senses.gloss: ch. <cite ref="U01310">same</cite>. Targ. II Esth. V, 8.—
units: <cite ref="Meilah 21a:17">Meïl. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>והא לאו בני ש׳ נינהו</he> but are they not disqualified as messengers? <cite ref="Meilah 21a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>עבדה שְׁלִיחוּתֵיה</he> it (the olive press) carried out his commission (intention); <he>ה״נ אתעביד שליחותיה</he> so in this case his commission was carried out (through irresponsible persons as through tools); a. e.
